before.name: Bernadette Naro
before.description:
Bernadette Naro is an activist documented in Nuclear Resister’s reporting on protest arrests.

On 2026-03-27, Bernadette Naro was arrested at Pentagon. Arrested during the Patrick O’Neill birthday peace witness at the Pentagon. Processing and release of the group took more than seven hours; this is not recorded as a full-day prison sentence. June court dates were scheduled, with no individual final disposition established here.
